events.what: 第 29 届常年股东大会

recent_en: VARIA held its 29th Annual General Meeting on 26 November 2026, with all resolutions passed. The company announced its consolidated quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 25 November. It also announced multiple proposals on 2 November and disclosed a change in substantial shareholder Teoh Boon Hing's interest on 4 November.
notable_en: The 29th AGM was held on 26 November 2026 and all resolutions were passed by shareholders.
The company announced multiple proposals on 2 November 2026.
Substantial shareholder Teoh Boon Hing had a change in interest on 4 November 2026.
